result: Implemented a full-capable one-pass sAlex production engine that can build the source-hash-bound membership index and observe the same materialized structures for WBM exact/near/prototype overlap without a second sAlex stream. Added a memory-bounded WBM target SQLite index, frozen-source production runner, and guarded workflow. A 10,000-record official-source throughput pilot is authorized; the 10,447,765-record full run remains fail-closed until pilot runtime/storage results are captured.
